title: RewardWinBulkUpdateBody
description:
Body for PUT /v1/reward-wins/update-objects/bulk.

Explicit allowlist of the fields the bulk-edit endpoint may change: the incentive `id`
(match key), Order Number, Tracking Number, Comment, and the archive flag. Everything else
on `RewardWinUpdateBody` (fulfillmentStatus, cost, value, tax fields, ...) is intentionally
excluded — tsoa strips unknown fields at the edge before they reach the controller. New
bulk-editable fields must be added here deliberately.
